claim_text: DNA sequence, DNA damage/adduct, DNA methylation, chromatin and gene expression are distinct endpoints and require distinct evidence.
falsifier: A validated method demonstrates that the named endpoints are interchangeable without loss of causal or measurement meaning.
acceptance_criterion: Every downstream claim declares endpoint, tissue/model, timescale, measurement and causal status.
next_gate: Validate ledger entries against the typed schema and cross-scale anti-conflation rules.

claim_text: Intentional behavior can alter physiological conditions that are associated with epigenetic and transcriptional adaptation; this does not establish voluntary editing of DNA sequence.
falsifier: Controlled replicated studies fail to show the specified mediated molecular effect or the effect is explained by confounding/batch/cell composition.
acceptance_criterion: Preregistered controlled intervention plus mediation analysis and independent replication with orthogonal biological readout.
next_gate: Use exercise as positive-control branch; keep generic conscious-intention-to-DNA-sequence claims TOKEN_VAZIO unless a molecular editing mechanism is defined.

claim_text: Dietary exposures must be separated by compound, dose, food-processing context and molecular endpoint; DNA adducts are not equivalent to fixed mutations or epigenetic changes.
falsifier: The claimed class-wide effect disappears when compounds/doses/endpoints are separated or when a distinct endpoint is measured directly.
acceptance_criterion: Exposure-specific controlled ledger with independent endpoint measurements and no mutation inference from adduct or methylation alone.
next_gate: Replicate standardized fried-food/acrolein-adduct measurements; treat zero-sugar beverages ingredient-by-ingredient.

claim_text: Ionizing radiation and non-ionizing electromagnetic fields require separate mechanisms and exposure metrics; generic EMF-to-DNA/cognition claims are not admissible without dosimetry and controls.
falsifier: Effect disappears under blinded sham, calibrated dosimetry and thermal matching or fails independent replication.
acceptance_criterion: Frequency/energy, dose/SAR/power or field, geometry, duration, temperature, sham and endpoint are bound to a reproducible protocol.
next_gate: Dosimetry-first blinded/sham protocol with thermal and hypothesized non-thermal branches separated.

claim_text: Bioelectric membrane signaling, PIEZO mechanotransduction and thermo-TRP sensing provide established physical-to-cellular transduction routes, but downstream gene programs remain tissue- and context-specific.
falsifier: The proposed downstream effect persists with selective blockade/perturbation and rescue results inconsistent with the nominated pathway.
acceptance_criterion: Dose-response plus sensor/channel perturbation, Vm/Ca2 readout, downstream readout and rescue in a specified model.
next_gate: Build causal cell/organoid protocol; do not universalize tissue-specific responses.

claim_text: Language and social norms can affect behavior through neural learning and cultural transmission, but social-field metaphors and Freudian constructs must not be mapped one-to-one onto physical EM fields or anatomical modules.
falsifier: The proposed effect is not distinguishable from domain-general cognition, reinforcement history, socioeconomic/environmental covariates or other mediators.
acceptance_criterion: Mediated path is measured with explicit covariates and no semantic-to-physical equivalence assumption.
next_gate: Model society/tradition to learning/reinforcement to behavior first; add molecular endpoints only with measurable mediators.

claim_text: Ultraweak photon emission is measurable in biological systems, but reliable extracranial attribution to brain-origin signal and functional neural communication remain unresolved.
falsifier: Signal is explained by detector background, residual light, scalp emission or optical attenuation and fails preregistered independent replication.
acceptance_criterion: Independent calibrated dark-enclosure replication with background/scalp/source controls and source-attribution evidence survives adversarial testing.
next_gate: Treat the 2026 contamination critique as mandatory adversarial control; no neural-communication promotion before source attribution survives it.
